In the short term, the share price has given back some ground, with a 1-day share price return of 2.04% lower and a 7-day share price return of 1.39% lower.
However, the 30-day and 90-day share price returns of 2.78% and 5.48% respectively point to momentum that aligns with upbeat Q3 news.
The 39.02% year-to-date share price return and 5-year total shareholder return of 100.67% indicate that Coca-Cola has rewarded patient holders over time.
